deployments_detail.use: Honda CI (Cooperative Intelligence) mapless autonomous driving + intent-understanding AI, targeting L4; Odawara City demos from Feb 2026 (CR-V, N-VAN e:)
Multi-agent generative AI system (developed Apr 2025) for Software-Defined Vehicle approach
Honda uses IBM watsonx generative AI to model its technical documentation as sentences, cutting documentation modeling time from three years to one year. [IBM watsonx]
deployments_detail.value: modeling time reduced from three years to one year

deployments_detail.use: SoundHound/Houndify voice AI powers the 'Honda Personal Assistant', a conversational in-car assistant for navigation, media, local search and vehicle controls, shipping in production Honda e and select Jazz models in Europe and Japan. [SoundHound / Houndify]

Google Gemini AI assistant is being deployed to Honda and Acura vehicles with Google built-in (Civic, Accord, CR-V, Pilot, Passport, Prologue, Prelude; Acura ZDX/MDX/ADX), replacing Google Assistant for hands-free natural-language navigation, search and vehicle control. [Google Gemini]

Honda's Digital Proving Ground, a cloud vehicle-development platform on AWS, applies ML/analytics to vehicle and EV battery telemetry to visualize energy consumption and performance and schedule preventative maintenance, and is being used to build software-defined vehicles. [AWS]

Honda is developing an EV charging experience using Amazon Bedrock generative AI to recommend the optimal charging station from a driver's behavior patterns, battery level, charging speed, fees and nearby amenities, for its 0 Series EVs. [Amazon Bedrock]

Honda signed a multi-year joint-development partnership with Helm.ai (and made an additional investment) to co-develop and validate AI-powered ADAS and autonomous driving software for mass-production EV/HEV models launching around 2027. [Helm.ai]
Honda works with Monolith AI, applying deep-learning/self-learning models to CAD-based parts design and engineering to predict design performance and reduce physical testing. [Monolith AI]
Honda R&D uses AI-driven materials exploration to search ternary and quaternary material combinations to accelerate next-generation EV battery development.

American Honda rolled out Microsoft 365 Copilot (formerly Bing Chat Enterprise) broadly to Office 365 employees for drafting, summarization and productivity, following a soft release and a phased ChatGPT Enterprise/Azure OpenAI pilot. [Microsoft Copilot / Azure OpenAI]
Honda's new GAC joint-venture EV plant in Guangzhou, China uses AI-driven welding and automation in production of the all-electric Ye P7, cutting costs and reducing human workforce needs.

Honda established a 'Gen-AI Expert' certification program and internal enablement system, and reports LLM tools such as ChatGPT are used daily across business operations; it is also researching a multi-agent generative-AI system inspired by its Waigaya culture (accepted at an AI conference). [OpenAI ChatGPT / LLMs]

Honda and Amazon Ads launched the 'Dream Generator', an interactive generative-AI marketing experience that combines user inputs with AI-generated visuals to create personalized animated films for the 2024 Prologue EV launch. [Amazon Ads (generative AI)]

Honda is developing an in-vehicle safety solution using Amazon Kinesis Video Streams and machine learning to analyze car camera footage and detect abnormal movement outside the vehicle to alert drivers. [AWS (Amazon Kinesis Video Streams)]
